parts:

models I was succesfully running on 1.0.1. Unfortunately, this time
the model compilation ended with an error, despite being exactly the
same as before. You will find the data, model and R code that produces
the error attached. The output of the compiler on my machine is
attached in error.txt file. I would be greatful for any tips how to
fix this:)

Cheers,
Marcel

parts:
Thanks for the detailed report though I tried in windows and cannot reproduce the error you have. 

An advice for reporting compiling error in RStan:
1) provide the g++ version (dump from g++ -v)
2) the error dump for function stan with verbose = TRUE

--
Jiqiang
